package.name: so_arm_100_kinematics
package.description: Closed-form FK/IK for the SO-100 5-DOF arm chain. Pure Python, zero ROS dependency by design -- this package is meant to be vendored verbatim into the Blender addon (so_arm_100_stick_assembly project), so it must run unmodified in Blender's bundled interpreter as well as here.
